questions.stem: What do phosphodiesterase inhibitors block, in terms of cyclic nucleotides?
questions.answer: Hydrolysis of cyclic AMP and cyclic GMP

questions.stem: How specific are most phosphodiesterase inhibitors for a single isoenzyme?
questions.answer: Poorly specific; most act on several isoenzymes

questions.stem: In the PDE3 group, which form breaks down cAMP made after beta-receptor stimulation?
questions.answer: The cardiac and smooth muscle form

questions.stem: What do PDE3 inhibitors do to intracellular cAMP?
Which three cardiac effects do PDE3 inhibitors have?
questions.answer: Increased contractility (inotropy), heart rate (chronotropy) and conduction velocity (dromotropy)

questions.stem: How do PDE3 inhibitors change platelet behaviour?

questions.answer: cGMP formed in response to nitric oxide

questions.stem: What do PDE5 inhibitors boost in penile erectile tissue?
Besides erectile dysfunction, which two conditions are uses of PDE5 inhibitors?
questions.answer: Primary pulmonary hypertension and persistent pulmonary hypertension of the newborn

questions.stem: What effect does higher cGMP have on platelets?
Which phosphodiesterase inhibitors may help inflammatory disease such as reactive airway disease?
Which phosphodiesterase types are found in the lung?
Which phosphodiesterase types mediate the anti-inflammatory lung effects of these drugs?
What future approaches to lung phosphodiesterase inhibition are suggested?
questions.answer: Low-dose non-specific inhibitors, or specific PDE4 or PDE7 inhibitors in development
